# Sensory Observation

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:SensoryObservation`](gmeow-SensoryObservation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SensoryObservation>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/observations`](../../slices/observations.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An observation produced by a sensor or sensory apparatus reading a physical property of the environment. Specialises [`Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md) with sensor-specific properties (sensory property, sensor platform, sampling feature).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:SensoryObservation`](gmeow-SensoryObservation.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

### Sensor Reading

- **Source:** [`slices/extensions/sensory/examples/sensor-reading.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/extensions/sensory/examples/sensor-reading.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-extensions-sensory-examples-sensor-reading)#example-slices-extensions-sensory-examples-sensor-reading

```turtle
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Blackcat Informatics® Inc. <paudley@blackcatinformatics.ca>
# SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0
#
# Worked example: a sensor reading on the observation stack . A
# gmeow:SensoryObservation records WHAT was sensed (gmeow:sensoryObservationOf),
# WHICH gmeow:ObservableProperty (humidity), and the gmeow:SensoryQuantity result.
# A gmeow:Sensor is a gufo functional complex that is also an Agent, so it is the
# observation's gmeow:vantage — the SensoryObservation is an Observation like any
# other, just produced by an instrument on a gmeow:SensorPlatform at a location.
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/sensory/> .
@prefix rdfs:  <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .

# --- The reading: what, which property, the result, the sensor as vantage, and
#     the method (a SensoryObservation is a core Observation — it records its
#     gmeow:observationMethod like any other).
ex:obs a gmeow:SensoryObservation ;
    gmeow:sensoryObservationOf ex:greenhouse ;
    gmeow:sensoryProperty      ex:humidity ;
    gmeow:sensoryResult        ex:quantity ;
    gmeow:vantage              ex:dht22 ;
    gmeow:observationMethod    gmeow:methodInstrumentalReading .
```

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use when the observation is a reading taken by a sensor or sensory apparatus of a physical property of the environment — the form that travels in a [`gmeow:Stream`](gmeow-Stream.md) and carries sensor/platform/sampling-feature detail.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for a human judgement or a derived/computed value (use [`gmeow:Measurement`](gmeow-Measurement.md) with the matching [`gmeow:observationType`](../properties/gmeow-observationType.md)) and for a standpoint assertion ([`gmeow:StandpointClaim`](gmeow-StandpointClaim.md)); this kind is specifically instrument-mediated sensing.

### How to use

- Type the reading [`gmeow:SensoryObservation`](gmeow-SensoryObservation.md), put the sensor or platform in [`gmeow:vantage`](../properties/gmeow-vantage.md) (or [`gmeow:streamSensor`](../properties/gmeow-streamSensor.md) / [`gmeow:streamPlatform`](../properties/gmeow-streamPlatform.md) when streamed), and attach the value as a [`gmeow:ScalarQuantity`](gmeow-ScalarQuantity.md) result; group time-ordered readings under a [`gmeow:Stream`](gmeow-Stream.md).

### Examples

- ex:humidityReading a [`gmeow:SensoryObservation`](gmeow-SensoryObservation.md); [`gmeow:vantage`](../properties/gmeow-vantage.md) ex:hygrometer.
